items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: we was in the band together

ctx.x: Yeah. Well he learned that kind of stuff I think basically from working with Earl Bostic for a while. Earl Bostic taught him some different fingerings and stuff like that. So but he was a very conscientious guy man. He, like we was in the band together, he used to work, he would work all, you know work the sets, play a half hour solo or something, and then get off the stand and go in the corner and stand up and practice. And then come back on and do the same thing again, and do that all night long. In fact one…
It turned out to be magic. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
